facility.name: Little Bit of Home
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 909 PINE ST, CARRIZO SPRINGS, TX, 78834

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Documentation for emergency practice drills between January through July 2026 was unavailable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of four children's records evalauted were lacking up to date immunizations on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two seperate caregivers were observed walking out of a classroom and leaving the children unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The operational policies were lacking the parents rights.    This was corrected at inspection when the operation was provided with a copy of form 2987 Parent's Rights. The form will be attached to the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The loose-fill for a 5 foot slide was not maintained at the required 6 inch depth at the exit of the slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two out of three employee records evaluated had out of date first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: A caregiver was lacking 11 out of the 24 annual training hours for the most recent year completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two out of three employee records evaluated had out of date CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Three out of five children's records evaluated were lacking a complete health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Four out of five child records evaluated were lacking an admission date.    This was corrected at inspection when the admission dates were added to all records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver without an active or eligible background check was present in a classroom at the operation.     This was corrected when the caregiver was asked to leave the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of five child records evaluated were lacking immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: The director was lacking 16 out of the 30 annual training hours for the most recent year completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The center was missing criteria for extreme weather in their operational policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The center was missing the inclusion services with children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: The center did not have proper amount of loose fill for slide that was approximetly 6 feet tall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The operation did not have a use zone of 6 feet for the ladder that leads to 6 foot slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation failed to submit the number of employees that have left their employment in 2023 by January 15th.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Cribs was not labeled to identify which child sleeps in each crib.  CI: This was corrected hen the caregiver labeled each crib with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation lacked a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed with five infants with the specified age of 11 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed to be in charge of 5 children, who had not received eligibility notice to work at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: The Director had six of the required thirty hours of training for the last full year of employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: One out of three staff files reviewed did not have training in the following areas for review.   Pre service training with SIDS.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: There were 36 children observed to be present in care, however the operation's capacity is 35.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: An eleven month old infant was observed sleeping in a crib while drinking a bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two out of four children's records lacked immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
